source_issue.title: Document cypress commands, retrofit them to existing tests

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on documenting Cypress commands in the Plone Volto project and updating existing tests to use these documented commands. Many commands currently lack proper documentation, causing inconsistency in their usage.

## What needs to be done
1. Document the Cypress commands available in the [support folder](https://github.com/plone/volto/tree/main/packages/volto/cypress/support).
2. Update existing tests to utilize these commands effectively, ensuring that tasks align with their intended commands.
3. Consider renaming commands for clarity, possibly adding a "volto" prefix (e.g., `cy.voltoToolbarSave()`).

## Helpful background
Cypress is a testing tool for web applications. The Volto project has many custom commands defined but lacks a comprehensive reference and consistent usage across tests. It's important to have a clear naming convention and documentation to assist new contributors in understanding available commands.

## Good first steps
1. Review the current Cypress commands listed in the [support folder](https://github.com/plone/volto/tree/main/packages/volto/cypress/support).
2. Identify which commands are not currently used in tests and think about where they could be applied.
3. Update the documentation for these commands. 
4. Explore existing tests to find opportunities for refactoring using the documented commands. 
5. Check ongoing pull requests to avoid duplicate efforts.
```
